stress.medium: Moderate activation or signs of accumulated load.
stress.high: High stress and reduced ability to adapt.
stress.fatigue: Under strong pressure, energy reserves very low.

recovery.insufficient: Insufficient recovery: the body struggles to relax and recharge.
recovery.poor: Poor recovery: more quality rest is needed.
recovery.moderate: Moderate recovery, with room for improvement.
recovery.good: Good recovery: the body regenerates well.
recovery.optimal: Optimal recovery: excellent capacity to relax and recharge.

balance.strongImbalance: Strong imbalance between activation and recovery.
balance.moderateImbalance: Moderate imbalance between activation and recovery.
balance.sufficient: Sufficient balance between drive and recovery.
balance.good: Good balance between drive and recovery.
balance.optimal: Optimal balance: speeding up and slowing down come easily.

adaptation.fragile: Fragile adaptation capacity: watch the loads.
adaptation.good: Good capacity to adapt to loads and return to balance.
adaptation.excellent: Excellent capacity to adapt to loads and return to balance.
